findings.highlight: She must have said something aloud on purpose.
findings.evidenceJa: 音をたてたのはワザとだろう
findings.governingReading: 音をたてた describes making a noise in the deliberately slow projectile test; no words or vocal utterance are supplied here.
findings.explanation: The deliberate noise of the Gandr test becomes deliberately speaking aloud.

findings.governingReading: 木刀を下げたまま locates the sword lowered as he emerges before fighting to question whether Kuzuki is manipulated.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s deliberately lowered weapon is no longer specified.

findings.governingReading: 詰めるは五間 gives the distance to close; the next sentence restates Saber covering ten meters while Caster casts faster.
findings.explanation: Saber closing five ken of distance becomes Caster reciting five verses.
